items.text: I'm proud to co-sponsor the #GlobalHERAct to repeal the harmful #GlobalGagRule, which can prevent access to health services like abortion, maternal & child health care, HIV prevention and treatment, nutrition services, and more for people and communities around the world.

November is Alzheimer's Awareness Month. I'm working with advocates like @alzct to secure more resources for Alzheimer's treatment & prevention, including new funding we passed in Congress to increase early diagnoses and reduce hospitalizations right here in Connecticut. https://t.co/QwPWkrnUnZ

We fought for record funding in Congress to upgrade our state's water infrastructure, replace lead pipes, and remove dangerous pollutants from the water supply. $61.4 million is on its way to support projects like Bristol's SCADA system that monitors water quality & treatment. https://t.co/HaQOZ0wNRM

Last week's disastrous court ruling threatens the future of IVF treatment for families in Alabama. House GOP is supporting a bill that could restrict treatment nationwide.

I'm cosponsoring legislation that protects IVF as we fight to restore reproductive freedom for all.

Thank you to the @mssociety of Connecticut for stopping by my office today! As we work to find a cure for multiple sclerosis, I'll continue to advocate for resources to ensure Americans with MS have access to the treatment and care they need to live happy and healthy lives. https://t.co/myFSCIW6ax
Sending strength to @RepRaulGrijalva as he undergoes treatment for cancer. We will continue to stand with you and wish you a full recovery.

In 2021, youth aged 13-24 accounted for 19% of new HIV diagnoses in the United States.

As a member of the @EqualityCaucus, I am working with my colleagues to expand access to HIV/AIDS testing and treatment. It is essential for our young people to get the care they need. https://t.co/BbpjqzTGHI

We saw firsthand the dangers of 'forever chemicals' when 50,000 gallons of PFAS foam spilled into the Farmington River. I worked to secure $19 million to expand water testing & treatment in CT and urged @POTUS to take this historic action to protect Americans from contamination.

Seniors shouldn't have to suffer from complications due to hearing loss simply because treatment is too expensive.

I worked with @POTUS to make hearing aids available over the counter, and now I'm cosponsoring @RepCartwright's HEAR Act requiring Medicare to cover hearing aids.

During Overdose Awareness Week, we mourn the lives lost to substance use disorder and continue to work to secure more resources for treatment and recovery. Visit https://t.co/9vuZBS3zBu or call 800-563-4086 for more information on treatment options and support.

This listeria outbreak is our nation’s largest since 2011. Recalled deli products are marked with an "EST. 12612" or "P-12612" label. To stay safe, do not eat the recalled products, clean your refrigerator, and seek treatment if you develop symptoms.
https://t.co/Qia0MyyFSv

I'm cosponsoring @RepBrownley’s Veterans Infertility Treatment Act to ensure unmarried & LGBTQ+ veterans have access to treatments like IVF. No veteran should be denied reproductive care because of who they are. That's why we're fighting to expand access to fertility treatments.

1 in 5 adults in the U.S. suffer from mental illnesses, but less than half receive treatment. On World Mental Health Day, we are working to expand access to mental health care and connect everyone with the resources they need. For support, call or text 988. https://t.co/cEwaiLVnLA

On #WorldAIDSDay, we honor the millions we’ve lost to the HIV/AIDS epidemic and continue to work to support access to testing, treatment, and prevention efforts.
 
We must ensure everyone living with HIV in the U.S and around the world can receive the care they need. https://t.co/ACfMWPa3qK

No one should be denied access to reproductive care because of who they are.

I introduced the Veterans Infertility Treatment Act with @RepBrownley to ensure unmarried & LGBTQ+ veterans have the same access to treatments like IVF at the VA as straight, married couples.

Seniors shouldn't have to suffer from hearing loss simply because treatment is too expensive.

I worked with @POTUS to make hearing aids available over the counter. Now, I’m cosponsoring @RepDebDingell’s bipartisan bill to ensure Medicare covers prescription hearing aids.

House Republicans want to pass cuts to Medicaid and SNAP to pay for a tax break for the wealthy.

I signed a discharge petition to force a vote on our bill to protect Americans' health care & nutrition benefits. We only need a few Republicans. Now is their chance to stand up.
I’m praying for @JoeBiden and his family during this time.   President Biden is resilient and a fighter. We are wishing him the best for his treatment and recovery.

1 in 5 adults suffer from mental illness, but less than half receive treatment. During Mental Health Awareness Month and every month, we are committed to ensuring everyone has access to the care they need. If you or a loved one are in crisis, call or text 988 for support. https://t.co/Mlsbqf3swY

The GOP tax plan:

💰 Gives an $89,000 tax cut to millionaires
🏥 Kicks 14 million Americans off health care
🛒 Eliminates nutrition assistance for 3.2 million Americans

Medicaid & SNAP shouldn't be cut so the wealthy get tax breaks. They should pay their fair share! https://t.co/5POOhqe46U

Thank you to everyone who joined me in West Hartford to discuss the GOP tax plan. Their bill cuts Medicare, Medicaid & nutrition benefits for millions to pay for tax breaks for the wealthy.

As it heads to the Senate, we must all keep speaking out against these devastating cuts. https://t.co/d84YWIFeIZ

The Republican budget bill cuts more than $300 billion from SNAP, eliminating nutrition assistance for at least 3.2 million Americans.

Families rely on these benefits to put food on the table. Kids shouldn't go hungry so billionaires can get a tax break. That's just cruel. https://t.co/7ESxYnbqRq

While Republicans in Congress try to cut taxes for billionaires, President Trump's tariffs will raise costs at the grocery store and everywhere you shop.

On top of that, their bill slashes nutrition benefits for millions of households! Americans can't afford these cruel cuts. https://t.co/Z9AD0sRrIY

All morning, Treasury Secretary Bessent dodged our questions in the @WaysMeansCmte on the Republican tax plan - with no focus on the facts.

Here's the truth: their bill makes massive cuts to Medicaid and SNAP nutrition benefits to pay for tax cuts for the wealthy. https://t.co/4t1qZJwK7A

The GOP tax plan would kick millions of Americans off their health care and food assistance to pay for tax breaks for the ultra-wealthy. 

They don't need another tax cut! I'm fighting to protect your Medicare, Medicaid, and SNAP nutrition benefits from these devastating cuts. https://t.co/zMQKLy5dsH
